item.g:title: Aventus 10J02 Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Aventus 10J02 is all about its smoke, which comes through with an ashtray like character that makes the scent feel very bold and challenging. It is not the easiest batch to appreciate right away, since the smokiness has an acquired taste and leans more rugged than crowd pleasing. In the mid, the fragrance stays woody and smoky, then gradually softens into a creamy musk vanilla drydown that gives the batch a smoother and more comforting finish.

item.g:title: Aventus 11Z01 Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Aventus 11Z01 has no noticeable pineapple presence and instead leans heavily into a smoky, oceanic, and salty profile that feels very distinctive from the usual fruity Aventus expectation. In the mid, a strong, clean, crisp, and almost pungent musk takes over, giving the fragrance a sharp and powerful character. As it dries down, the smokiness returns and leaves a lasting impression, but the smoke here feels especially unique, unusual, and difficult to compare to anything else, which is what makes this batch stand out so much.

item.g:title: Aventus 12D01 Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Aventus 12D01 opens with a distinct grilled pineapple note, as if the fruit has light charred marks, giving it a bold and memorable introduction. In the mid, the profile turns citrusy and earthy, adding depth and structure without losing freshness. The drydown reveals a smooth citrusy vanilla that feels refined and well integrated. item.g:title: Aventus 12F01 Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Aventus 12F01 is dominated by an intense, in your face smoke that immediately gives the fragrance a raw, almost burned woodland character. The smokiness is bold and uncompromising, yet it remains surprisingly wearable, showing the kind of refined and distinctive smoke that makes the original Aventus difficult to replicate. In the mid, a hint of fruitiness tries to come through, but the smoke stays firmly in control for nearly three hours before the scent finally softens into a musky vanilla drydown. It is a powerful and memorable batch that leans heavily into smoke while still ending on a smoother, more comforting finish.

item.g:title: Aventus 13ZZ01 Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Aventus 13ZZ01 opens with a strong burst of fruity pineapple, paired with a pungent musk and a well judged touch of smoke that gives the scent both brightness and depth. In the mid, a subtle saltiness emerges alongside the smokiness, adding a slightly rugged and more textured character to the composition. As it dries down, the fragrance becomes more citrusy and musky, leaving a cleaner but still distinctive finish. Performance is solid, with around 2 hours of projection and about 5 hours on skin.

item.g:title: Aventus 14K01 Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Aventus 14K01 is a stark departure from the modern fruity interpretations of Aventus, opening with a deep blend of earthy, mossy, and smoky notes that immediately signal a mature and authoritative character. The depth is striking, evoking a true time capsule effect that feels old-world and seasoned rather than playful. Despite the absence of a fruity opening, the Aventus DNA remains unmistakable, even recognizable to others. In the mid, a subtle pineapple note begins to surface, sharpened by assertive woods that add structure and edge. The drydown introduces a mix of saltiness, musk, and vanilla, grounding the fragrance into a powerful and long-lasting base. Performance is exceptional, with around 7 hours of projection and up to 20 hours of longevity.

item.g:title: Aventus 16H01 Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description:
Aventus 16H01 opens with a refined tart fruitiness that feels bright and composed rather than aggressive. The mid transitions into a fresh, citrus-forward profile that remains clean and airy, giving the fragrance an easy sense of movement and clarity. As it dries down, subtle woods emerge to provide balance and structure, preventing the composition from becoming too sharp or fleeting.
Overall, this batch leans toward the lighter side of the Aventus spectrum. It is smooth, approachable, and effortless to wear, making it a dependable option for daily use and warmer conditions without sacrificing the signature Aventus character.

As it settles, the fruit evolves into a smoother, richer pineapple accord with gentle sweetness, evoking depth without becoming candied. The drydown reveals a graceful fusion of vanilla and soft musk, creating an aura of subtly seductive sophistication. Long-lasting and elegantly composed, 17T01 delivers presence without aggression — a confident, modern classic with timeless appeal.

item.g:title: Aventus 17X01 Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: A refined and luminous interpretation of the Aventus style. The opening presents a crisp and uplifting pineapple brightness intertwined with a gentle wood undertone that feels clean and polished. As it transitions, the fragrance deepens with a sweeter pineapple nuance lightly accented by a delicate spark of bergamot for subtle energy and lift. The drydown reveals a soft veil of musk and quiet warmth, creating an elegant skin-close aura. Fresh, balanced, and effortlessly sophisticated — a scent that communicates clarity and class rather than volume or aggression.

item.g:title: Aventus 18D02 Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Aventus 18D01 opens with an overripe pineapple accord paired with light woods, giving it a rich but controlled introduction. As it moves into the mid, the profile becomes fruity and musky, maintaining a soft and understated character. In the drydown, a very subtle musky vanilla emerges on both skin and fabric, requiring close wear to fully appreciate. Even after 20 hours, the scent remains detectable on clothing, with occasional gentle wafts of projection.

item.g:title: Aventus 20J01 Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description:
Aventus 20J01 presents a darker character, comparable in depth to 16M01, but with its own distinct personality. The opening is earthy and woody, immediately setting a more serious and grounded tone, with a noticeable inky nuance reminiscent of a pentel pen that adds an interesting, almost industrial edge. As it develops into the mid, the woody profile remains dominant, but a subtle vanilla nuance begins to surface, softening the darkness and adding quiet richness.
In the drydown, citrus and musk emerge to lift the composition, creating contrast against the earlier heaviness while maintaining the recognizable Aventus DNA. Notably, the scent shows strong persistence, with traces of the DNA lingering on the skin even after washing with soap, highlighting its tenacity and staying power.

item.g:title: Dua Butterbeer Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: A whimsical scent for the imaginative and especially for the Harry Potter nostalgic at heart. The opening is a captivating mix of salted butter, sweet butterscotch sauce, and sparkling ginger ale effervescence. As it moves into the heart, the fragrance deepens into a darker, slightly bitter fizz with a warm oak undertone. The drydown becomes creamy and nostalgic, evoking vanilla ice cream drizzled with caramel. On clothing, it transforms into a rich root beer float aroma that lasts well into the next day. A delightfully unique fizzy gourmand.

item.g:title: Dua Poseidon Jr. Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Poseidon’s Jr. (Poseidon’s 11Z01 x Poseidon’s Elixir 2.0) opens with a bright, fresh, syrupy pineapple accented by very minimal woods, giving a clean and vibrant first impression. As it moves into the mid, the woods stay restrained while a soft whisper of the Aventus signature vanilla slowly emerges, adding smoothness and balance. In the drydown, it settles into a woody, musky base with vanilla, coming across almost like light plywood wrapped in vanilla and musk 😆 Overall, it is a bright, easy-to-wear blend and a clear step up from MOD 1 (11Z01 x 13ZZ01).

item.g:title: Dua Poseidon's Elixir Remixed MOD 1 Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Poseidon’s Elixir MOD 1, a combination of 11Z01 x 13ZZ01, opens with a strong salty, musky, and aquatic character that immediately dominates the top. As it moves into the mid, the intensity becomes more subdued but remains largely unchanged, with the fruity pineapple character of an Aventus batch being almost unrecognizable. In the drydown, the fruitiness of 13ZZ01 finally emerges, though it is still laced with lingering saltiness. Overall, the scent comes across as aggressive and overwhelming, to the point of being dizzying and unsettling.

item.g:title: Dua Supernova Cologne Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Supernova Cologne smells closer to Elysium Parfum Pour Homme than the Cologne version, since it gives off more of that juicy, slightly oriental character rather than a citrus forward freshness. Instead of leaning crisp and sparkling, the scent feels fuller and richer in a way that makes it come across deeper than expected for a cologne style release. Because of that, I find the 30 ml formulation more appealing, especially for its more noticeable citrusy top that gives the scent a brighter and fresher opening.

item.g:title: Local Niche TBGCO Blanc Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Blanc may share a similar clean linen style category on paper, but the actual scent comes across very differently. It opens with a watery freshness touched by a soft hint of saffron, giving it a smooth and airy introduction rather than a straightforward laundry profile. After a few minutes, a gentle sweetness emerges that resembles white sugar, adding a delicate softness to the composition. In the drydown, the fragrance settles into a creamy sandalwood note reminiscent of Pegasus, layered over a skin scent style base of musk and ambroxan, resulting in a clean, polished, and quietly addictive scent.

item.g:description: Elysium Special Edition surprised me by being distinct from both the Cologne and Parfum Pour Homme versions. item.g:title: Niche Amore Mio Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Amore Mio opens with a soft mandarin orange and bergamot, bright but quiet. In the mid, a thick, creamy floral heart blooms across heliotrope, gardenia, jasmine, ylang ylang, violet, and rose, an oriental sweetness building underneath. The drydown is cacao, rum, vanilla, tonka bean, and sandalwood over a touch of cumin and saffron, a semi gourmand warmth that sits close to the skin. Performance is long, lasting all day with a soft intimate sillage.

item.g:title: Niche Severo Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Severo opens with a freshly cracked Coca Cola accord, rum and lime fizzing on top in a Cuba Libre cocktail effect. In the mid, smoky birch, davana, and black pepper temper the boozy sweetness, lending a green woody bitter edge that keeps it from going syrupy. The drydown is vanilla, white musk, and amber, smooth and dry. Refreshing, characterful, and surprisingly long after the cocktail opening.

item.g:title: Niche Mile High 58 Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Mile High 38 is the perfect balance of simplicity and complexity. It opens with smooth, fruity pineapple reminiscent of Aventus, then gradually transitions into the dry, herbaceous immortelle facet associated with Sunshine Man. In the drydown, creamy whipped notes and blow-torched brown sugar emerge, echoing Bake. Notably, the creaminess leans more toward a sunscreen-like texture rather than a heavy gourmand or lactonic feel. This is my most successful blind buy and a true work of art.

item.g:title: Niche Bake Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Bake opens with a bright lemony note that quickly melts into a whipped cream accord. It evokes the memory of buttery, chewy fondant icing, the kind you’d secretly snack on as a kid, rather than traditional buttercream. As it dries down, the scent deepens into a caramelized brown sugar profile, reminiscent of a blow-torched crème brûlée. A standout gourmand and easily my favorite in the category.

item.g:title: Niche Pegasus Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Pegasus is a fragrance I initially found puzzling, questioning why anyone would want to smell like almond. Over time, it completely won me over. It opens with a creamy, metallic almond note before revealing a beautifully smooth sandalwood in the drydown. Elegant, comforting, and quietly confident, this scent suits someone accomplished yet humble, and can even work in daytime conditions with the right breeze.

item.g:title: Middle Eastern Tubbees Bubble Gum Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Bubble Gum opens with a bright, minty sweetness that can initially come across like a child's toothpaste, giving it a playful and slightly nostalgic freshness. After a closer smell, the scent shifts into something much more familiar, evoking the distinctly sweet, chewy character of classic Bazooka bubble gum. The result is a fragrance that feels fun, youthful, and candy like, with a sugary profile that leans heavily into childhood nostalgia.

item.g:title: Middle Eastern Tubbees Cookies & Cream Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Cookies & Cream opens with the unmistakable scent of a cookies and cream Cornetto, then quickly brings to mind crisp chocolate chip cookies dipped in fresh milk. There is a distinct baked cookie batter quality here, slightly toasted and crispy from the heat, alongside a rich sweetness that makes the chocolate chips and creamy milk stand out clearly. The milk note is especially indulgent, dense and sweet without becoming nauseating, giving the fragrance a fuller and more comforting gourmand character.

item.g:title: Middle Eastern Afnan 9PM Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Ultra Male inspired. Afnan 9PM carries the highly addictive scent DNA of its JPG Ultra Male inspiration, built around a rich blend of lavender, cinnamon, and vanilla that feels sweet, warm, and instantly seductive. What makes it stand out is the way the pear note adds a distinct juicy smoothness, giving the fragrance a more unique and recognizable character. Rather than coming across as aggressively loud, it feels more intimate and controlled, with a softer presence that still projects.

item.g:description: Aventus inspired. Black Leather is a fragrance that leans into a very fruity pineapple profile balanced by just the right amount of woodiness. item.g:title: Middle Eastern Rumz Al Rasasi 9325 Pour Lui Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Aventus inspired. Pour Lui blends tangy lemon, sweet pineapple, and a light woody base into a highly wearable and easy to enjoy fragrance. The scent has a bright and uplifting character that feels smooth, clean, and versatile, with a vibe that comes close to Allure Cologne but without the ginger sharpness. What makes it especially appealing is how polished and pleasant it smells throughout, without carrying the usual harsh or synthetic impression often associated with some Middle Eastern style releases.

item.g:title: Middle Eastern Dumont Nitro Black Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Aventus inspired. Nitro Black Intense is a fruity, woody, and slightly smoky take on the Aventus style DNA, but what gives it a more distinctive edge is the subtle metallic nuance in the scent. That faint metallic touch adds an extra layer of sharpness and character, making it feel less straightforward and more interesting than a typical fruity woody composition. The result is a fragrance that still feels familiar in structure, yet stands out enough to have its own identity.

item.g:title: S&L Cacao Nibs Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Original creation. Cacao Nibs opens with an earthy, dry chocolate note that feels darker and more grounded at the start, then gradually softens into a creamier chocolate milk character through the mid. As it settles, the scent becomes warmer and more familiar, resembling a rich chocolate cake style fragrance with a smoother and sweeter finish. Its progression makes it appealing for chocolate lovers, especially with its impressive longevity, lasting around 15 hours on both skin and clothes.

item.g:title: S&L To Hide a Smoker Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Original creation. To Hide a Smoker EDP has a sweet, warm, and nostalgic cola profile that immediately brings to mind gummy cola candy, with a texture that feels soft, chewy, and almost sparkling. The tobacco note stays very subtle, adding only a faint depth in the background rather than pushing the fragrance into anything dark or heavy. Because of that, the scent remains highly wearable and easy to enjoy, leaning more into a cozy gourmand character with a playful cola sweetness. It lasts for more than 8 hours and stays consistently pleasing without becoming tiring.

item.g:title: S&L Carefree Fragrance Decant (2ml)
item.g:description: Original creation. Carefree smells like fresh laundry linen with a watery, airy quality that makes it feel clean and light from the start. As it develops, the mid is dominated by tea and aloe vera, giving the fragrance a soft, soothing, and slightly green freshness. In the drydown, the tea remains while musk becomes more noticeable, leaving a smooth and comforting clean scent trail. It lasts around 5 hours on skin and about 13 hours on clothes.

item.g:title: TBGCO Captivate EDP Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Captivate EDP is similar to the permanent listing version, but this one stands out because of its well blended smoke accord. The smoke adds a darker and more textured layer to the fresh Aventus inspired profile, giving the fragrance more depth and personality without overwhelming its brightness. While the smokiness may come across stronger at first, it settles into something smoother and more wearable over time, making the overall composition feel more balanced. Compared with Extrait V1 and V2, this version feels more distinctive, as the smoke gives extra character to the freshness and makes the scent more dynamic.

item.g:title: TBGCO Captivate V1 Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Captivate V1 opens with a syrupy pineapple accord wrapped in a noticeably musky character, giving this older bottle a deeper and more textured take on the Aventus inspired profile. The sweetness associated with the BR540 style DNA remains present and becomes more dominant in the mid, adding a rich and slightly airy sweetness that softens the composition. As it dries down, the musk becomes noticeable again, giving the fragrance a smoother and more mature finish. In this form, the added musk actually improves the scent, as it blends naturally with the Aventus style structure and gives it a more appealing depth.

item.g:title: TBGCO Temptation Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Temptation is an enticing fragrance built around a bold apple and burnt sugar combination that immediately gives it a rich, sweet, and attention grabbing character. The scent has a warm spicy edge that adds depth to the sweetness, making it feel more seductive and polished rather than simply sugary. Its strong projection makes it especially noticeable in enclosed spaces, while the overall profile feels smooth, inviting, and perfectly suited for date night.

item.g:title: TBGCO Serene Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Serene comes across to me as a smooth and calming blend of tea, neroli, mint, and a subtle aquatic touch, even if some of those nuances are not reflected in the official note breakdown. The combination gives the fragrance a clean, airy, and effortlessly laid back character that feels extremely easy on the nose. What stands out most is how soft and swabe the scent feels overall, leaning more into quiet freshness than sharp projection, though it also seems like the kind of fragrance that can make the wearer go nose blind fairly quickly.

item.g:title: TBGCO Eau Benite Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Eau Benite is a difficult fragrance to pin down by notes alone, coming across as a blend of fresh spicy nuances, soft white florals, and an airy incense character. The overall impression feels clean, uplifting, and subtly sacred, with a watery freshness that gives it the effect of holy water meeting the gentle smoke of church incense. It has the refined atmosphere of a newly built, upscale church, cool, polished, and quietly reverent, making it a fragrance that feels serene, spiritual, and distinctly church appropriate.

item.g:title: TBGCO Hypnotic Holiday Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Hypnotic Holiday opens with a slight touch of mint and sea notes that give the fragrance a cool and airy freshness, while cinnamon, toffee, and lavender add warmth, sweetness, and an aromatic smoothness underneath. The contrast between the fresh opening and the richer supporting notes gives it a balanced character that feels both inviting and distinctive. Overall, it comes across as a scent that blends freshness and sweetness in a soft, well rounded way.

item.g:title: TBGCO Aventus Blanc Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Aventus x Blanc opens with a fresh and ripe pineapple accord that feels soaked in water, brightened further by a clean neroli touch and a slight kick of saffron. The opening has a crisp and airy fruitiness that feels especially appealing, but as the fragrance develops, Blanc gradually takes over the composition. What begins as an Aventus led blend eventually settles into a soft, clean scent profile that resembles a freshly laundered duvet, making the overall impression smooth, comforting, and effortlessly elegant.

item.g:title: TBGCO Captivate Cacao Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Captivate Cacao opens like a chocolate pineapple upside down cake, decadent and moist with juicy pineapple toppings. In the mid, the Aventus pineapple meets the woody Cedrat Boise warmth, the BR540 lifting the cacao note into a richer gourmand center. The drydown stays moist and indulgent, the chocolate softened into a unique cocoa pineapple closing. A creative and memorable gourmand take on the Aventus DNA.

item.g:title: TBGCO Captivate Sedley Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Captivate Sedley is a surprisingly inventive blend that takes the fizzy, Sprite like freshness of Sedley and adds a touch of sweet pineapple, creating a scent that feels both sparkling and juicy at the top. As it develops, the drydown brings out a more pronounced cola nuance, likely enhanced by the BR540 style sweetness, shifting the character from a lemon lime soda impression into something deeper and more reminiscent of Pepsi Blue. The result is a highly unique fragrance that combines bright effervescence, fruity sweetness, and a playful cola twist in a way that feels unusual and memorable.

A bold floral Aventus interpretation.

item.g:title: TBGCO Captivate Strawberry Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Captivate Strawberry is a bold quadbrid that blends Aventus, Cedrat Boise, BR540, and strawberry into a scent that feels both familiar and completely unusual at the same time. The pineapple accord carries a slightly candy like twist, giving it a fruity character that recalls strawberry candy while still sitting on top of the woody, musky, and airy structure underneath. The result is a highly unique fragrance that feels like Aventus reimagined with a vivid strawberry edge, combining bright fruitiness and sweetness in a way that stands out even against many niche compositions.

item.g:title: TBGCO Under The Influence w/o canna Fragrance Decant (1ml)

item.g:title: Inspired Warthog Stud Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Warthog Stud is a more wearable take on the DHI style DNA, especially for those who find the iris in the original too strong or overwhelming. It keeps that smooth, powdery, and slightly elegant character, but presents it in a softer and easier to wear way. The result is a fragrance that still feels polished and refined, while being more approachable and comfortable on the nose.

item.g:title: Inspired Warthog Patchouli Haven Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Warthog Patchouli Haven opens with a refreshing burst of bright orange citrus, giving the scent an energetic and inviting start. As it dries down, the fragrance turns darker, slightly bitter, and more earthy, with patchouli becoming the clear focus of the composition. The contrast between the lively citrus opening and the deeper patchouli base gives it a bold and satisfying character, making it especially appealing in colder weather where its richness can fully shine.

item.g:title: Inspired Warthog Dark Elixir Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Dark Elixir is a lavender forward fragrance with the note staying prominent from the opening to the drydown, while honey and tobacco remain subtle but noticeable enough to add warmth and depth. The scent feels like a creative hybrid, combining the lavender and pear style smoothness of Ultra Male with the honey tobacco richness associated with Le Male Elixir. Even with those darker sweet elements, it stays controlled and wearable, giving the fragrance a balanced character that feels comforting, slightly seductive, and easy to wear without becoming too heavy.

item.g:title: Aventus 21T01 Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Aventus 21T01 presents a darker character, comparable in depth to 16M01, but with its own distinct personality. The opening is earthy and woody, immediately setting a more serious and grounded tone, with a noticeable inky nuance reminiscent of a pentel pen that adds an interesting, almost industrial edge. As it develops into the mid, the woody profile remains dominant, but a subtle vanilla nuance begins to surface, softening the darkness and adding quiet richness. In the drydown, citrus and musk emerge to lift the composition, creating contrast against the earlier heaviness while maintaining the recognizable Aventus DNA. Notably, the scent shows strong persistence, with traces of the DNA lingering on the skin even after washing with soap, highlighting its tenacity and staying power.

In the drydown, citrus and musk emerge to lift the composition, creating contrast against the earlier heaviness while maintaining the recognizable Aventus DNA. Notably, the scent shows strong persistence, with traces of the DNA lingering on the skin even after washing with soap, highlighting its tenacity and staying power.

item.g:description: Aventus inspired. Imperia opens with a strong lemony Aventus style DNA that may come across a little sharp at first, but the fragrance becomes far more rewarding as it develops. item.g:description: Imagination opens with a bright citrus impression, but as it develops, the tea note becomes the true focus of the scent. item.g:title: Designers JPG Le Male Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Le Male is a classic minty tonka fragrance with a mouthwash like freshness that gives it a cool, clean, and slightly medicinal opening. The mint comes across as sharp and aromatic in a way that immediately recalls the brisk sensation of a strong blue mouthwash, but it is softened by the sweetness underneath so it never feels sterile or harsh. As it develops, the tonka adds warmth, creaminess, and a lightly sugary depth that rounds out the mint and turns that fresh opening into something more sensual and comforting. The result is a fragrance that feels both clean and seductive, with a signature balance of barbershop freshness and sweet warmth.

item.g:title: Designers JPG Ultra Male Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: JPG Ultra Male carries a highly addictive scent DNA built around the rich blend of lavender, cinnamon, and vanilla, creating a sweet, warm, and seductive profile that feels instantly appealing. What makes it stand out is the way the pear note adds a distinct juicy smoothness that gives the fragrance a more unique and recognizable character, something many similar releases fail to capture. Rather than coming across as aggressively loud, it feels more intimate and controlled, with a softer presence that stays close to the skin and makes the scent feel less attention seeking and more effortlessly inviting.

item.g:title: Designers JPG Le Male Elixir Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Le Male Elixir is a lavender forward fragrance where the note remains prominent from the opening all the way to the drydown, giving the scent a smooth, aromatic backbone throughout its development. The honey and tobacco stay in the background, but they are present enough to add warmth, sweetness, and a slightly deeper texture without overpowering the composition. This balance makes the fragrance feel rich and sensual while still maintaining a clean, polished structure anchored by its strong lavender character.

item.g:title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Dendros 420 Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Dendros 420 opens with a profile that sits somewhere between Irish Spring soap and an intensely green shampoo, delivering an immediate feeling of cleanliness and freshness. The fragrance has a pronounced cooling effect that feels incredibly relaxing, almost like stepping out of a cold shower after a long and exhausting day. The green facets give it a natural and uplifting character, while the soapy freshness keeps it familiar and easy to wear. There is something calming about the scent, as if it slows everything down and creates a peaceful atmosphere around the wearer. Refreshing without being sharp and comforting without being heavy, Dendros 420 excels as a feel good fragrance that leaves you feeling clean, rejuvenated, and mentally refreshed.

item.g:title: Prime Monkey New Prime Monkey Royal Zest Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Royal Zest opens with around ten minutes of nonstop fizz, capturing the sparkling sensation of bubbling and popping carbonation with impressive realism. Even after an hour, it still carries that familiar orange soda character, keeping the scent playful, vibrant, and true to its name. As it dries down, the fragrance settles into a musky orange finish that feels softer and smoother while still retaining its citrus identity. It also performs surprisingly well on clothes, lasting around 10 hours. Note: current formulation, clear juice.

item.g:title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Icarus Wings Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Icarus Wings opens wet and bright, a wash of citrus over cool marine air that reads like sea spray in morning light. item.g:title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Planet Befall Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Planet Befall opens with a bright cascade of mandarin and orange over crisp bergamot, luminous and immediately uplifting. item.g:title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Behemoth Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Behemoth wears like its name, a large, warm, and openly masculine scent built for cold air and close company. The impression is smoky and woody, the kind of fireside warmth that fills a room rather than whispers, with a sweet resinous edge running underneath. It holds that heavy, cozy character through most of its life before softening into a warmer skin trail. This is a scent for evenings and cold weather, and it asks for a light hand, since a little of this kind of depth carries a long way.

item.g:title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Cosmic Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Cosmic opens warm and inviting, orange blossom and bergamot dusted with cinnamon and cardamom, a spiced sweetness that feels almost edible from the first moment. The heart is all comfort, a rich bourbon vanilla folding into a nutty praline warmth that gives the scent its cozy, gourmand pull. The dry down settles into soft amber and creamy woods, sitting close to skin and quietly addictive. It is a cold weather crowd pleaser, sweet and easy to love, though anyone who prefers sharp or fresh compositions may find it too warm and dessert leaning.

item.g:title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Shadowmere Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Shadowmere opens on honey and cinnamon, a golden, almost candied sweetness that carries a faint curl of smoke from the very start. The heart deepens into warm amber and resin, where the honey turns darker and more grown up, sitting somewhere between dessert and incense. As it dries, vanilla and tonka smooth everything into a soft, smoky sweetness that lingers close and long. This is a rich cold weather and evening scent made for skin contact, and its heavy honeyed character is meant to be indulgent, so it will feel like too much to anyone chasing something light.

item.g:title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Glaukos Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Glaukos is built to be liked, a soft, clean freshness that reads as fresh laundry and good manners more than anything loud. It opens light and bright, settles into a gentle soapy warmth, and never strays far from that easy, approachable feeling. The dry down is a quiet musky cleanliness, the sort of scent that suits a classroom, an office, or a first meeting. It is honest about what it is, an unfussy daily wear rather than a signature, so anyone chasing complexity will find it simple by design.

item.g:title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Ethereal Noir Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Ethereal Noir opens crisp and luminous, bright citrus threaded with the dry, elegant lift of black tea. The heart stays clean and airy, the tea note giving it a refined, almost transparent sophistication rather than any real darkness, despite the name. It dries into a soft woody musk with a touch of warm amber, close to skin and easy to live with. This is a versatile, uplifting scent that performs well in heat, and its lightness is the whole point, so anyone expecting a heavy noir from the title will find it far brighter than it sounds.

item.g:title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Neroli Kaze Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Neroli Kaze carries the same bright, tea touched DNA as the house's Ethereal Noir, turned further toward orange blossom and neroli. item.g:title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Nexus Ultra Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Nexus Ultra opens cool and sweet, a bright mint and lavender freshness lifted by juicy pear, crisp for a moment before the sweetness takes hold. The heart warms quickly, cinnamon and soft spice bridging into a smooth, syrupy vanilla that defines the scent's character. The dry down is warm amber and vanilla with a clean musk, sweet and long lasting on skin and fabric alike. This is a bold, unmistakably sweet crowd pleaser for cooler weather and nights out, and its candied heart is a signature you either love or leave rather than an everyday quiet wear.

item.g:title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Alpha Vortex Zenith Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Alpha Vortex Zenith opens crisp and energetic, green apple and grapefruit over bright bergamot for a clean, just showered freshness. item.g:title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Valor 420 Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Valor 420 takes the fruity Aventus style DNA the Valor line is known for and pulls it somewhere greener and smokier. It opens with the familiar bright pineapple and fruit, then a dry, green smokiness rolls in, herbal and slightly resinous, giving the fruit an unexpected edge. The heart holds that tension between juicy sweetness and dry green smoke before mellowing into a soft woody musk. This is the most characterful twist in the Valor family, made for someone who likes the fruity signature but wants a rougher, greener spin, and that smoky green streak is an acquired taste rather than a crowd pleaser.

The heart holds that tension between juicy sweetness and dry green smoke before mellowing into a soft woody musk. This is the most characterful twist in the Valor family, made for someone who likes the fruity signature but wants a rougher, greener spin, and that smoky green streak is an acquired taste rather than a crowd pleaser.

item.g:title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Valor Teqrose Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Valor Teqrose is the most playful spin in the family, the fruity Valor DNA laced with the boozy, floral twist its name points to. Expect the familiar fruit opening lifted by a bright, slightly boozy sparkle and a soft rose, a pairing that reads sweeter and more festive than the straighter Valor scents. The heart keeps that rosy, fruity warmth before it settles into a smooth musky base. This is a fun, distinctive take for someone who wants the Valor fruit with a floral, celebratory edge, and its sweeter character sets it apart from the cleaner variants.

item.g:title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Emperium Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Prime Monkey's reading of Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum. It opens with cardamom over a warm bergamot, spicy and bright for only a moment before the sweetness arrives. An hour in a toffee and caramel accord takes the centre, rich but smooth rather than sticky, resting on amberwood. The drydown is warm and woody with the sweetness still glowing underneath. A cold weather crowd pleaser.

item.g:title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Royal Zest Fragrance Decant (1ml)
item.g:description: Royal Zest opens with around ten minutes of nonstop fizz, capturing the sparkling sensation of bubbling and popping carbonation with impressive realism. Even after an hour, it still carries that familiar orange soda character, keeping the scent playful, vibrant, and true to its name. As it dries down, the fragrance settles into a musky orange finish that feels softer and smoother while still retaining its citrus identity. It also performs surprisingly well on clothes, lasting around 10 hours. Note: previous formulation, blue tinted juice.
